blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Several foundation models dedicated to hyperspectral images have recently been made available. These models are trained on large unlabeled datasets and exhibit strong performance on many hyperspectral imaging tasks, such as classification or denoising. Nonetheless, their performance for hyperspectral unmixing – the task of separating mixed spectra of overlapping materials in a hyperspectral image – remain understudied. This might partly be due to the fact that most of them rely on vision transformer backbones, including patchification, leading to a feature resolution problem. While hyperspectral unmixing already arises from the low resolution of hyperspectral images, this patchification step potentially makes the problem even more ill-posed. Therefore, in this work, we aim to answer two questions: 1) how do foundation models perform in hyperspectral unmixing? ; 2) how to tackle the feature-level loss of resolution? To answer the first question, we benchmark foundation models for unmixing, showing that they can reach state-of-the-art performance on four hyperspectral unmixing datasets. To answer the second question, we compare several feature upsampling approaches and empirically show that using a simple one can lead to high performance results. The code is available at https://gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/hfm-hsu.git .
blocks.zh: 最近提供了若干专门处理超光谱图像的基础模型。 这些模型都接受了大型无标签数据集的培训,并在许多超光谱成像任务(如分类或解析)上表现出很强的性能. 尽管如此,它们在超光谱解密方面的性能 — — 在超光谱图像中将重叠材料的混合光谱分离出来的任务 — — 仍然没有得到足够的研究。 其部分原因可能是,大多数都依赖于视觉变压器骨干,包括补丁,导致特征解决问题。 虽然超光谱解密已经产生于超光谱图像的低分辨率,但这一补丁步骤有可能使问题更难掌握. 因此,在这项工作中,我们的目标是回答两个问题: 1) 基础模型如何在超光谱解密中发挥作用? (2) 如何解决特征级分辨率的丧失? 为了回答第一个问题,我们把基础模型作为不混合的基准,表明它们可以在四个超光谱不混合数据集上达到最先进的性能. 为了回答第二个问题,我们比较了几种特征抽样方法,从经验上表明,使用简单的方法可以导致高性能结果。 该代码可见于https://gitlab.telecom-paris.fr/ring/hfm-hsu.git.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Hyperspectral images are composed of numerous narrow neighbouring spectral bands. Applied to remote sensing, this rich spectral content can be used to analyse the materials present in the scene, offering a vast set of applications in agriculture, mineral mapping, and space exploration [ 1 ] . Yet, due to physical constraints, hyperspectral images (HSI) have a poor spatial resolution: every pixel corresponds to a large area of the scene ( e.g. around 30 meters on the ground for satellite images) that likely contains more than one material. Thus, most observed pixels’ spectra are a mixture of “pure materials” spectra, limiting the user’s capacity to directly exploit the image. To alleviate this issue, hyperspectral unmixing (HSU) aims to decompose image pixels into a mixture of pure material spectra. In particular, blind HSU aims to estimate both the pure material spectra (endmembers) and their relative concentrations (abundances).
blocks.zh: 超光谱图像由众多狭小的相邻光谱带组成. 应用于遥感的这种丰富的光谱含量可用于分析现场的材料,在农业、矿物测绘和空间探索方面提供了广泛的应用[1]。 然而,由于物理上的限制,超光谱图像(HSI)的空间分辨率差:每个像素都对应着场景的大面积(例如地面上大约30米的卫星图像),可能包含一个以上的材料. 因此,大多数观测到的像素光谱都是"纯材料"光谱的混合体,限制了用户直接利用图像的能力. 为了缓解这一问题,超光谱解密(HSU)旨在将图像像素分解成纯物质光谱的混合物. 特别是盲目的HSU旨在估计纯物质光谱(最终成员)及其相对浓度(丰度)。

blocks.en: Due to its simplicity, the Linear Mixture Model (LMM), which assumes pixels to be a linear combination of the endmembers, is often used [ 1 ] . Mathematically, let Y ∈ ℝ B , N Y\in\mathbb{R}^{B,N} denote the matricised HSI with N N pixels ( N = H ​ W N=HW , H H and W W are the spatial dimensions) and B B spectral bands, E ∈ ℝ B , C E\in\mathbb{R}^{B,C} the endmember matrix with C C pure materials and A ∈ ℝ C , N A\in\mathbb{R}^{C,N} their corresponding abundance maps. The LMM can be written:
blocks.zh: 由于简洁,常使用线性混合模型(Linear mixture Model,LMM),该模型假定像素是最终成员的一种线性组合,因此常使用[1]. 在数学上,让Y → R B,N Y\in\ mathb{R}^{B,N}表示母体HSI与N像素(N=H W N=HHW,H和WW是空间维度)和B B光谱带,E → R B,C E\\\mathb{R}^{B,C}端成员矩阵与C纯材料和A → R C,N A\in\mathb{R}^{C,N}它们相应的丰度图. LMM可以写:

blocks.en: Y = E ​ A + ε , Y=EA+\varepsilon, (1)
blocks.zh: Y = E A + + + + + , Y = EA + varepsilon, (1)

blocks.en: where ε ∈ ℝ B , N \varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}^{B,N} denotes additive noise. The LMM is often complemented by the abundance non-negativity constraint (ANC) and the abundance sum-to-one constraint (ASC).

blocks.en: I-A HSU state-of-the-art and motivation
blocks.zh: I-A HSU 最新技术和动力

blocks.en: Due to their simplicity, pure pixel retrieval algorithms such as VCA [ 2 ] or N-FINDR [ 3 ] have quickly become popular in HSU. However, these approaches suffer from the fact that the pure-pixel assumption is rarely fulfilled in practice; optimisation-based methods leveraging more complex handcrafted priors such as minimum volume [ 4 ] or sparsity [ 5 ] have thus taken the lion’s share during the last decade.
blocks.zh: 由于简洁,VCA[2]或N-FINDR[3]等纯像素检索算法在HSU迅速流行. 然而,这些办法受到这样一个事实的影响,即纯像素假设在实践中很少实现;基于优化的方法利用了更复杂的手工前科,如最小体积[4]或螺旋[5],因此在过去十年中占据了狮子的份额。

blocks.en: With the rise of deep learning, HSU has advanced significantly, particularly through convolutional architectures (CNNs), including CNNAEU [ 6 ] and UnDIP [ 7 ] . More recently, vision transformers (ViTs) such as DeepTrans [ 8 ] and A2SAN [ 9 ] have built on self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range spectral dependencies, while Mamba-based models like ProMU [ 10 ] have introduced efficient state-space modeling for spectral data. Additionally, adversarial schemes, including SSST-GAN [ 11 ] , have been explored for blind HSU, learning underlying data distributions. Alternatively, some attempts have tried to bridge the gap between deep learning and optimization approaches [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 随着深入学习的兴起,HSU取得了显著进步,特别是通过革命建筑(CNNs),包括CNNAEU[6]和UnDIP[7]. 最近,DeepTrans[8]和A2SAN[9]等视变器(ViTs)基于自觉机制来捕捉远程光谱依赖性,而ProMU[10]等基于曼巴的模型为光谱数据引入了高效的状态-空间模型. 此外,还为盲目的HSU探索了对抗计划,包括SSST-GAN[11],学习基础数据分布。 或者,一些尝试试图弥合深入学习与优化方法之间的差距[12]。

blocks.en: Although these works have been reported to obtain accurate results, the networks are often trained based on an autoencoder-like framework over a single image. This can be partly explained because manual HSU labelling requires considerable time and expertise, and therefore only a few scenes are annotated with the corresponding endmembers and abundances. Nonetheless, this is a big difference from many other computer vision tasks, where the networks often benefit from a vast amount of data.
blocks.zh: 虽然据报道这些作品获得了准确的结果,但这些网络往往在一个单一图像上根据类似自动编码器的框架进行培训。 部分原因可以解释,因为手动HSU标签需要相当长的时间和专门知识,因此只有几个场景附有相应的终端成员和丰富的内容。 然而,这与许多其他计算机远景任务大不相同,在这些任务中,网络往往受益于大量数据。

blocks.en: I-B Hyperspectral foundation models and contributions
blocks.zh: 超光谱基础模型和贡献

blocks.en:
Despite this scarcity of annotated HSU images, researchers have recently gained access to vast unlabeled datasets of HSIs. This has enabled the development of Hyperspectral Foundation Models (HFMs), starting in 2024 with the seminal work of [ 13 ] . These HFMs, trained on large datasets, extract a representation of the input HSI, called features, that enables performing many downstream tasks without having to retrain the model for them.
Several HFMs were proposed: some of them use pixel-level feature encoders, such as HyperSIGMA [ 14 ] , HyperSL [ 15 ] or UniverSat [ 16 ] . Other rather use patch-level features: HyperFree [ 10 ] , DOFA [ 17 ] , Panopticon [ 18 ] , SpecViT (from SpectralEarth [ 19 ] ) and SpecAware [ 20 ] . Pixel-level encoders extract a representation of every pixel in the image, while patch-level encoders extract a representation of an entire patch, losing the fine details at the pixel scale.
blocks.zh:
尽管缺乏附加说明的HSU图像,研究人员最近还是获得了大量无标签的HSI数据集. 这使得Hyper光谱基础模型(HFMs)的开发成为可能,从2024年开始以[13]的开创性工作开始. 这些HFM在大数据集方面受过培训,提取了输入HSI的表示,称为特性,能够执行许多下游任务,而无需为其重新训练模型.
提出了几个HFM:其中一些使用像素级特性编码器,如HyperSIGMA [14],HyperSL [15]或UniverSat [16]. 其他使用补丁级功能:HyperFree [10],DOFA [17],Panopticon [18],SpecViT(来自光谱地球[19])和SpecAware [20]. 像素级编码器提取图像中每个像素的表示,而补丁级编码器提取整个补丁的表示,丢失了像素尺度上的精细细节.

blocks.en: In turn, patch-level encoders raise a specific issue for HSU: their features cannot be used directly, since the practitioner needs the proportion of each material at every pixel, not at the patch level. HyperFree [ 10 ] , the only paper using a patch-level HFM for HSU, does not explain how it handles this issue, and no code is available. This leaves a gap in the literature on how to use low-resolution feature HFMs for HSU.
blocks.zh: 反过来,补丁级编码器为HSU提出了具体问题:其特性不能直接使用,因为从业者需要每个像素的材料的比例,而不是补丁级别. HyperFree [10],是HSU唯一使用补丁级HFM的纸张,没有解释它如何处理这个问题,也没有代码可用. 这在文献中留下了如何为HSU使用低分辨率特征HFM的空白.

blocks.en: More generally, only a limited number of results using HFMs for HSU were presented. The authors of [ 14 ] were the first to propose the use of HFM for HSU, but they only tested it on a single simple dataset. Later, HyperFree [ 10 ] reported comparable performance on the same dataset, and another article [ 21 ] suggested using HyperSL for HSU, but we couldn’t reproduce the reported performance. Therefore, while there seems to be a rising interest in using HFMs for unmixing, existing literature still lacks a proper assessment of their performance over several datasets, with the associated codes for reproducible research.
blocks.zh: 更一般地说,只有有限的几项成果是使用高频调频对高频进行介绍。 [14]的作者首先提议HFM用于HSU,但他们只在单一的简单数据集中测试. 后来,HyperFree [10] 在同一数据集上报告了可比较的性能,另一篇文章[21]建议HSU使用HyperSL,但我们无法复制所报告的性能. 因此,虽然人们似乎越来越有兴趣使用HFM进行不混合,但现有文献仍然缺乏对几个数据集的性能的适当评估,相关的编码用于复制研究。

blocks.en: In this context, the contributions of this work are the following: • we benchmark HFMs on the unmixing task over several datasets in order to better understand their performance in HSU. To this end, we build on a model-agnostic framework that performs unmixing directly from HFM features. • We compare several feature upsampling strategies for patch-level HFM features.
blocks.zh: 在这方面,这项工作的贡献如下: • 我们根据若干数据集的未混合任务,将HFM作为基准,以便更好地了解它们在HSU中的表现。 为此,我们利用一种模式-不可知框架,直接从HFM特性中实现不混合。 我们比较了几个用于补丁级HFM特性的特征检测策略.

blocks.en: we benchmark HFMs on the unmixing task over several datasets in order to better understand their performance in HSU. To this end, we build on a model-agnostic framework that performs unmixing directly from HFM features.
blocks.zh: 我们把HFMs作为几个数据集的解密任务的基准,以便更好地了解它们在HSU中的性能. 为此,我们基于一个模式-不可知框架,直接从HFM特性中实现不混合。

blocks.en: We compare several feature upsampling strategies for patch-level HFM features.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了几个用于补丁级HFM特性的特征检测策略.

blocks.en: II Methodology
blocks.zh: 二. 方法

blocks.en:
To benchmark the existing HFMs’ unmixing performance, we implement an unmixing model-agnostic framework, described in subsection II-A , taking as input a resolution-augmented version of the HFMs’ features. The resolution augmentation step, necessary to handle the loss of resolution in the ViT-based HFMs’ feature space, is itself discussed in subsection II-B . Please note that this step can be removed when using HFMs operating at pixel level ( e.g. [ 16 ] ). The training loss is described in subsection II-D .
The whole framework is summarised in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
为了衡量现有HFM的无混合性能,我们采用了分节II-A描述的无混合模型不可知性框架,将HFM的特性作为解析版本作为投入。 决议增强步骤是处理基于ViT的HFMs特性空间中分辨率损失所必须的,它本身也在第二-B小节中讨论。 请注意,在使用以像素水平运行的HFM(如[16])时,可以删除这一步骤. 培训损失载于第二至D小节。
图1概述了整个框架。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Proposed HFM unmixing framework, divided into three blocks: the feature extraction block (forward pass through a frozen HFM, with Y Y standardised following each model’s specification), the feature resolution-augmentation block, and the unmixing auto-encoder block, based on a CNN auto-encoder architecture.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议的HFM解码框架,分为三个块:特性提取块(前传通过一个冻结的HFM,YY按照每个模型的规格标准化),特性解码块,以及基于CNN自动编码器架构的解码自动编码块.

blocks.en: II-A Unmixing Auto-Encoder
blocks.zh: II-A 解密自动编码器

blocks.en: For the unmixing block, we use a classical auto-encoder structure, similar to the one in [ 6 ] . We estimate abundances as latent vectors and use a linear decoder to mimic the LMM; its weights are then associated with the endmembers.
blocks.zh: 对于不混合块,我们使用古典的自动编码器结构,类似于[6]中的. 我们估计丰度为潜在矢量,并使用线性解码器来模仿LMM;然后其重量与最终成员相关。

blocks.en:
In detail, our unmixing block takes as input the resolution-augmented features derived from the considered HFM (see subsection II-B ) and aims to reconstruct the HSI.
The convolutional encoder reduces the spectral dimension of the high-resolution feature from D D to C C with a 2D CNN layer, followed by a LeakyReLU non-linearity, a 2D Batchnorm layer, a dropout layer with probability 0.2 0.2 and finally a Softmax layer enforcing both the ANC and ASC constraints ( 1 ). The HSI is then reconstructed using a single matrix multiplication, increasing the spectral dimension from C C back to B B . The decoder weights are initialised with a first guess of the endmembers obtained using the SiVM algorithm [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
具体地说,我们未混合的块将来自考虑的HFM(见第二-B分节)的分辨率强化特征作为投入,目的是重建HSI。
转录编码器将高分辨率特性的光谱维度从D到C减少,带有2D的CNN层,然后是LeakyReLU非线性,2D的Batchnorm层,概率为0.2的退出层,最后是软max层,同时执行ANC和ASC的制约(1). 然后利用单一矩阵乘法重建HSI,将光谱维度从C回向BB. 解码器的权重被关闭,首先猜测使用SiVM算法获得的终端成员[4].

blocks.en: II-B Resolution augmentation of the HFM features
blocks.zh: 二-B 增强高频特性

blocks.en: Most vision transformer-based foundation models extract features at the patch level in the input image. This means that the HSI is patchified with a patch size p p , resulting in features F LR ∈ ℝ D × α × α F_{\text{LR}}\in\mathbb{R}^{D\times\alpha\times\alpha} where α = ⌊ H p ⌋ \alpha=\lfloor\frac{H}{p}\rfloor , and D D is the embedding dimension. To obtain pixel-wise abundance estimation, the resolution of this feature map has to be augmented back to image resolution F HR ∈ ℝ D , H , W F_{\text{HR}}\in\mathbb{R}^{D,H,W} . We have tested several methods covering a wide range of approaches for this task.
blocks.zh: 大多数基于视觉变压器的基础模型在输入图像中提取补丁级的特征. 这意味着HSI用补丁大小 p 进行补丁,导致特性 F LR → R → α → F → text{ LR\in\ mathbb{ R\\D\times\ alpha\ times\ alpha} 其中 α =\\\\ H p \ alpha \ llode\ frac{ H}{p}\rrode, D 是嵌入维度 。 要获得像素偏移的丰度估计,这个特性图的分辨率必须增强到图像分辨率F HR QQ R D,H,W FQQText{HR}}\in\mathbb{R}^{D,H,W}. 我们试验了几种方法,涵盖执行这项任务的各种办法。

blocks.en: We explored several widespread image super-resolution methods, including a non-learned method using a bilinear upsampling (as in HyperSigma [ 14 ] ), which interpolates the four nearest neighbour pixels. We also tested learned convolutional architectures: 1) deconvolution reverses the roles of input/output in convolution by inserting zeros and applying transposed convolutions; 2) Pixel Shuffle [ 22 ] expands channels via stride-1 convolution and rearranges them spatially; 3) the FiLM feature fusion method [ 23 ] , which combines bilinear upsampling of low-resolution features with high-resolution HSI details predicted by a series of trainable 2D convolutions: F HR = f 1 ​ ( up ​ ( F LR ) ⋅ f 2 ​ ( Y ) + f 3 ​ ( Y ) ) F_{\text{HR}}=f_{1}(\text{up}(F_{\text{LR}})\cdot f_{2}(Y)+f_{3}(Y)) . Here, f 1 f_{1} is a depthwise 2D convolutional layer with a kernel size of 3, D D input and output channels and a padding of 1; f 2 f_{2} and f 3 f_{3} are 2D convolutional layers with a kernel size of 1, B B input channels and D D output channels; and up denotes the bilinear upsampling function.
blocks.zh: 我们探索了几种广泛的图像超解析方法,包括采用双线式升标法(如HyperSigma [14]),将四个近邻像素内插. 我们还测试了所学的革命建筑: 1)通过插入零并应用转录曲折来解析进/输出在曲折中的作用;2)皮克斯舒夫尔[22]通过strip-1曲折扩展频道,并在空间上进行重排;3)FiLM特征聚变法[23],将低分辨率特征的双线性提升样本与一系列列车2D曲折预言的高分辨率HSI细节相结合:F HR = f 1(上(FLR) → f 2 (Y) + f 3(Y) ) F_{\Text{ HR}}=f_{1}(\text{up}(F_{\Text{LR}})\cdot f_{2}(Y)+f_{3}(Y). 在此,f 1 f_{1}是深智的2D 演化层,内核大小为3,D D 输入和输出通道,并加注1;f 2 f_{2}和f 3 f_{3}是2D 演化层,内核大小为1,B B 输入通道和D D 输出通道;上方表示双线性提升功能.

blocks.en: Directly related to our goal, we also experimented with feature-upsampling networks, such as FeatUp [ 24 ] , which is trained to enforce consistency across low-resolution feature maps under small image transformations, and NAF [ 25 ] , an attention-based method we trained on the SpectralEarth dataset to reconstruct high-resolution features.
blocks.zh: 与我们的目标直接相关,我们还试验了地物拓扑网络,例如FeatUp [24],在小图像变换下,在低分辨率地物图上执行一致性的培训,以及NAF [25],这是我们为重建高分辨率地物而训练的基于注意力的方法.

blocks.en: Finally, we also tested a trained linear mapping approach (as in [ 8 ] ), which learns a direct transformation W up ∈ ℝ α 2 , H ​ W W_{\text{up}}\in\mathbb{R}^{\alpha^{2},HW} from low- to high-resolution feature spaces. It can be written as F HR = W up ​ F LR F_{\text{HR}}=W_{\text{up}}F_{\text{LR}} , with W up W_{\text{up}} learned. We will show in subsection III-D that this approach experimentally corresponds to the best strategy.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们还测试了一个训练有素的线性绘图方法(如[8]),它学习了直接的转变W Up → R α 2 , H W_{\Text{up}}\in\ mathbb{R}^{\alpha^{2},HW}从低分辨率到高分辨率的特性空间. 它可以写成F HR = W up F LR F_{\text{ HR}}=W_{\text{ up}}F_{\text{ LR}} ,其中W up W_{\text{ up}} 已學到. 我们将在第三至D分节中表明,这种方法在实验上与最佳战略相对应。

blocks.en: II-C Ensemble Learning Trick
blocks.zh: II-C 集成学习技巧

blocks.en: We experimentally observed that a simple way to obtain better performance is to use an ensemble learning method [ 26 ] . We run n n independent training runs of the described framework to obtain n n estimates of A ^ i \widehat{A}_{i} and E ^ i \widehat{E}_{i} , and retrieve the final unmixing prediction by averaging these individual predictions: A ^ = 1 n ​ ∑ i = 0 n A ^ i ​ , and ​ E ^ = 1 n ​ ∑ i = 0 n E ^ i . \widehat{A}=\displaystyle\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=0}^{n}\widehat{A}_{i}\text{, and }\widehat{E}=\displaystyle\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=0}^{n}\widehat{E}_{i}. (2)

blocks.en: This improves the estimation quality while reducing the variability of the model, at the cost of a slight increase in computation time.
blocks.zh: 这提高了估计质量,同时降低了模型的可变性,而计算时间略有增加。

blocks.en: II-D Training loss
blocks.zh: 二-D 培训损失

blocks.en: The proposed unmixing framework is trained end-to-end in an unsupervised manner by minimising a mixture of losses :

blocks.en: III-E HFM benchmark for HSU
blocks.zh: 三-E 高频基准

blocks.en:
To evaluate our proposed framework, we compare the averaged scores obtained on 10 independent training runs with 7 state-of-the-art methods. These methods span a diverse range of approaches, from classic optimisation methods using SiVM and FCLS [ 4 ] [ 28 ] , to CNNs with CNNAEU [ 6 ] and UnDIP [ 7 ] , ViTs with DeepTrans [ 7 ] , A2SAN [ 9 ] , GANs with SSST-GAN [ 11 ] , and Mamba with ProMU [ 29 ] (we could not get results on the Urban dataset using the available code). To these methods, we compare all the previously mentioned HFMs 1 1 1 For HyperSL, we had to crop the Urban dataset to size 128 × 128 128\times 128 for memory issues; extracting features from images of size 224 × 224 224\times 224 uses more than 100 GB VRAM, and HyperFree’s available pretrained weights were missing the positional embedding, making it impossible to use. , once integrated into our pipeline. Table II displays the results obtained with DOFA (DOFA v1-large, as we observed better results than with v2), Panopticon, SpecViT-b, SpecAware and UniverSat using the proposed framework (without the mapping block for UniverSat, as it is a pixel-level encoder). We also provide results obtained with ( n = 15 n=15 ) and without ( n = 1 n=1 ) the ensembling method.
Qualitative results about the estimation of abundances on the Apex dataset are shown in Figure 3 .
blocks.zh:
为了评价我们提议的框架,我们比较了10次独立培训的平均分数和7种最新方法。 这些方法涉及各种各样的方法,从使用SiVM和FCLS的经典优化方法到CNNAEU [4][28]和UnDIP [7]的CNN、使用深传输的ViTs [7]、A2SAN [9]、使用SSST-GAN [11]的GANs和使用ProMU [29]的Mamba(我们无法利用现有代码获得城市数据集的结果)。 与这些方法相比,我们比较了前面提到的所有HFM 1 11 SL,我们不得不将城市数据集裁剪为128×128128\times128,用于内存问题;从224×224/224\time的图像中提取特征,224使用超过100GB VRAM,HyperFree可用的预加载重量缺失了位置嵌入,使其无法使用。 一旦融入我们的管道。 表二显示了通过DOFA(DOFA v1-很大,因为我们观察到的结果比v2更好),Panopticon,SpecViT-b,SpecAware和UniverSat使用拟议框架(没有UniverSat的映射块,因为它是一个像素级编码器)获得的结果. 我们还提供以(n = 15 n = 15)获得的结果,不采用(n = 1 n = 1)综艺法。

blocks.en: We observe that HFMs can achieve results comparable to the state-of-the-art in HSU. Moreover, we observe better performance with models that extract low-resolution features than with pixel-level encoders, highlighting the value of working with ViTs, even if they introduce a spatial downsampling. Finally, we note that the ensembling method enhances the quality of the prediction, even if a single training can already achieve decent performance. We note that the computational overhead of doing 15 trainings remains smaller than a single training of the unmixing part of HyperSIGMA or HyperSL.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,HFM能够取得与HSU最先进的成果相当的结果. 此外,我们观测到在提取低分辨率特征的模型上的性能优于像素级编码器,突出了与ViTs合作的价值,即使它们引入了空间下采样. 最后,我们注意到,综艺方法提高了预测的质量,即使一次培训已经能够取得体面的业绩。 我们注意到,进行15次培训的计算间接费用仍然比HyperSIGMA或HyperSL未混合部分的单一培训要小。

blocks.en: IV Conclusion
blocks.zh: 四. 结论

blocks.en: In this letter, we showcased the ability of foundation models to perform efficient unmixing by introducing a simple-to-implement, model-agnostic method allowing us to benchmark HFMs on the HSU task. We showed that they can achieve state-of-the-art performance while benchmarking different potential solutions to the resolution loss introduced by ViT-based models.
blocks.zh: 在这封信中,我们展示了基础模型通过引入一个简单到可知的模型方法来高效地实现解混的能力,从而使我们能够将HSU任务作为HFM的基准. 我们显示,它们能够实现最先进的业绩,同时为基于紫外线的模型引入的分辨率损失的不同潜在解决方案设定基准。

blocks.en: Appendix A Choice of the Feature Mapping
blocks.zh: 附录A 地物映射的选择

blocks.en: Tables III , IV , V and VI detail the SAD and NMSE obtained by the unmixing networks using all tested upsampling methods, with Panopticon and SpecAware as the HFMs. We display the results with both a single training ( n = 1 n=1 ) and the ensemble method ( n = 15 n=15 ). We also show the ranking of each method, using the method described in subsection III-B , as well as an average of the metrics over all datasets for easier comparison ( Avg. ). These tables show that the FiLM layer outperforms the linear mapping when running only one training run (without the ensembling method). We suggest that under limited computational resources, a single training of the unmixing framework using the FiLM layer will produce the best results. However, if more resources are available, an ensembling of 15 trainings using the linear mapping layer will result in even better performance.

blocks.en: To assess the importance of the HFMs as feature encoders, we replaced the low-resolution feature input of the linear mapping layer with 1) random noise and 2) a downsampled version of the input HSI. We observed the impact on the quality of the unmixing, using SpecAware as the feature extractor. The results are reported in Table VII and show that using the features provided by the HFM enables a significant improvement in the quality of the unmixing.

blocks.en: Appendix C Further Tests on the Resolution Augmentation Architecture
blocks.zh: 附录C 关于分辨率增强结构的测试

blocks.en: To analyse the performance of the proposed resolution augmentation architecture, we tried to permute the mapping and unmixing blocks. In detail, we first unmix the low-resolution features using the proposed abundance estimation CNN. A low-resolution estimation of the abundances is obtained and mapped back to high-resolution using the linear layer. It is then forwarded to the decoder to reconstruct the input HSI ( Figure 4 ). Table VIII contains the results obtained with both methods and shows that the proposed method: first projects the features to high resolution and then unmixes, achieves the best performance.
blocks.zh: 为了分析拟议的决议增强结构的性能,我们试图对绘图和未混合块进行修正。 详细来说,我们首先利用拟议的丰度估计CNN来解析低分辨率特性。 利用线性层获得对丰度的低分辨率估计,并将其映射回高分辨率。 之后转发到解码器,以重建输入的HSI(图4). 表八载有两种方法获得的结果,并显示拟议方法:首先将特征投射到高分辨率,然后解密,实现最佳性能.

blocks.en: Figures 6 to 11 provide other visual comparisons of the HFMs using the proposed framework to the other state-of-the-art methods on the Samson, Jasper, and Urban datasets, in addition to the Apex dataset presented in the letter. We can see that HFMs surpass most state-of-the-art methods, and the ones using our proposed framework surpass HyperSIGMA and HyperSL. In particular, we can see that our method is expressive enough to capture the correct variations in intensity in the water and the road in the Jasper dataset, for example. In the same way, we can see that the HFMs are able to extract fine details in the road and the soil in the Urban dataset.
